title: 한국농공학회논문집 2022년 제64권 5호
headline: 서울대학교 연구진이 3편으로 가장 활발했습니다.
bullets: 새로 등장한 키워드: ‘flood vulnerability · 홍수취약성’, ‘Small reservoir’, ‘condition assessment’, ‘defect evaluation’, ‘evaluation index · 평가지수’.
주로 쓰인 방법론: GCM/상세화, 기후변화 시나리오, AHP, 기계학습(일반).

papers.title: 수소생산을 위한 바이오매스 가스화 반응의 실험적 고찰
papers.title_en: Experimental Assessment of Biomass Gasification for Hydrogen Production

summary.result: Allothermal reaction resulted in higher concentrations of hydrogen with the supply of steam over air, reaching over 60%.
summary.background: Hydrogen can be produced by gasification of biomass and other combustible fuels.
summary.method: Experiments were conducted to investigate the channges in hydrogen concentrations in syngas with different oxidant agent conditions, fuel conditions, and external heat supply.

papers.title: 바이오매스 합성가스 적용을 위한 LPG 엔진발전기 개조 및 성능평가
papers.title_en: Modification of an LPG Engine Generator for Biomass Syngas Application

summary.result: The results found from the experiment show that the LPG engine generator operated on syngas can be adopted with a de-ration rate of 73.78 % compared to its regular operating fuel.
summary.background: The present research was aimed at modifying the existing LPG engine generator for fully operated syngas.
summary.method: The composition of produced syngas was analyzed using a gas analyzer and its composition was; 13~15 %, 10.2~13 %, 4.1~4.5 %, and 11.9~14.6 % for CO, H 2 , CH 4 , and CO 2 respectively with a heating value range of 4.12~5.01 MJ/Nm 3 .

papers.title: AHP 기법에 의한 농업용 저수지의 상태평가 기준 설정
papers.title_en: Establishment of Condition Assessment Criteria in Agricultural Reservoirs by AHP

summary.result: The safety grade of the reservoirs evaluated by applying the newly presented importance values in this study showed the rearrangement of the grades with a change of 11% compared to the previous grades.
summary.background: In this study, in order to establish the criteria for evaluation of importance by the type of facility specialized for agricultural reservoirs, an expert group consisting of a total of 167 members who were in management, or specialized in the fields of design, research, and diagnosis were organized, and the importance for facilities was set with application of the AHP technique.
summary.method: The importance of dam body, spillway, and intake structure composing a reservoir were set at 59%, 24%, and 17%, and the importance of dam crest, upstream slope, and downstream slope constituting a dam body was set at 32%, 31%, and 37%, respectively.

papers.title: 데이터 기반 모델에 의한 강제환기식 육계사 내 기온 변화 예측
papers.title_en: Data-Based Model Approach to Predict Internal Air Temperature in a Mechanically-Ventilated Broiler House

summary.result: The results indicated that the all models gave good predictions for 1-minute future air temperature showing the coefficient of determination greater than 0.99 and the root-mean-square-error smaller than 0.306℃.
summary.background: The smart farm is recognized as a solution for future farmers having positive effects on the sustainability of the poultry industry.
summary.method: Three machine learning models and a mechanistic model based on thermal energy balance were used for the prediction.

papers.title: 농업분야 탄소인지예산제도 도입을 위한 국가연구개발사업의 탄소저감 기여도 평가 방안
papers.title_en: Evaluation Methods of Carbon Reduction Contribution for Green Budget of National R&D Projects in Agricultural Sector

summary.result: The results of this study propose three methods to estimate the monetary costs and carbon benefits by adopting the framework for the economic evaluation of national R&D projects conducted by the Rural Development Administration.
summary.background: Carbon neutrality is emerging as a new paradigm for the international society by transiting from climate change to climate risk.
summary.method: Finally, the proposed methods were tested and verified for the efficiency and validity of evaluating carbon reduction contribution.

papers.title: 기후변화 시나리오에 따른 소규모 저수지의 홍수 취약성 평가 - 경기도 내 저수지를 중심으로 -
papers.title_en: Assessment of Flood Vulnerability for Small Reservoir according to Climate Change Scenario - Reservoir in Gyeonggi-do -

summary.result: In the past period (2000s), the number of D and E grade reservoirs was 58, but it was found to increase to 107 in the 2055s period.
summary.background: Most of the reservoirs managed by the city and county are small and it is difficult to respond to climate change because the drainage area is small and the inflow increases rapidly when a heavy rain occurs.
summary.method: The flood vulnerability of reservoirs due to climate change was evaluated using the concept provided by the IPCC.

papers.title: 반강결 프레임 구조물의 시스템 신뢰성 해석 - 비닐하우스를 중심으로 -
papers.title_en: Structural System Reliability Analysis of Semi-rigid Connected Frame - Focused on Plastic Greenhouse -

summary.result: The failure probability of the frame member component and the overall structure system was significantly different in consideration of the semi-rigid connection.
summary.background: Recently, the trend in structural analysis and design is moving towards the development of reliable system.
summary.method: Various conditions of correlation were applied to reflect the connectivity between members, and through this, the limitations of existing structural analysis method and the behavioral characteristics of structure were analyzed.
